## Per-Component Breakdown — Out of Scope

A per-component cost breakdown isn't something I can provide here — this tool is scoped to totals (LOW/EXPECTED/HIGH, core/recurring/annual/one-time), confidence, assumptions, pending items, and scope explanations, not itemized line-by-line cost breakdowns per component.

For the SYNC_BATCH estimate, I can re-confirm the top-line figures already shown: **$18.00/month** (EXPECTED), all attributed to the single processing component B1, with LOW confidence due to reliance on the planning-default DBU/hour assumption. Since there's only one included component in this request, the total *is* effectively B1's cost — but I can't produce a multi-component itemized table beyond that.

If you have additional components (e.g., SQL, transfer, storage) to include, I can calculate a new combined total and explain its confidence/assumptions the same way.
